title: Fresh held-out English comprehension eval R3 (48 examples, 6 families)
note: HELD-OUT EVAL ONLY. Never use for training. Same families and answer-key policy as eng_train.json (free_answer_policy: mechanical normalization, then exact match against accepted_answers; yes_no accepts only Yes/No).
